message:
The other day, I was rummaging through my closet and stumbled upon an old backpack from when my grandkids were little. It was filled with mismatched toys, half-eaten snacks, and a few forgotten art supplies. I chuckled at the thought of that being my emergency go-bag! It got me thinking about how easy it is to forget about being truly prepared amidst the daily hustle and bustle.

I realized that having a proper go-bag is more than just throwing things together; it’s about being ready for what life throws our way, even if it’s just a rainy day at the park. So, I took a moment to jot down what I really need: some water, important documents, and a few comfort items. And let me tell you, if I can make a new plan, anyone can! What’s your go-to item for unexpected days?
